messages:
Sarah C: Heads up — we need to lock the console/observability Q3 scope today. Major asks from PM/customers: dashboards revamp (per-route latency + cost), basic tracing links, error-analysis UI, and configurable retention tiers. Any blockers?
Mike L: Agree on scope, but tracing UI needs backend work first. I'd prioritise ingest/query perf and a simple trace link -> full trace host. :wave:
Anita P: Customers are asking for 12mo retention options for logs/metrics. Compliance teams expect explicit retention tiers in the console.
Kevin R: 12mo is doable but storage/cost plumbing required. Suggest tiered S3 + lifecycle + a cost dashboard. Can land a prototype by EOW Q3 if we don't include real-time reingest.
Priya S: Add docs and migration flow to launch criteria. We need sample alerts, runbook, and FAQ for customers who change retention.
Sarah C: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
```
- Dashboards: per-route latency, token-cost breakdown, top-10 errors
- Tracing: sampled traces + link from span -> trace viewer (no complex span search)
- Error analysis: grouped errors + one-click sample requests
- Retention: tier selector in console, billing estimate, and automatic downsampling policy
- Rollout: staged canary with 3 existing enterprise customers
- Docs: migration guide + runbook owned by DevEx
```
Thoughts?
Mike L: OK on dashboards & retention UI. For tracing: sample + links only. We need an SLO: dashboard query p95 < 200ms. Also need a toggle for disabled sampling in Dedicated clusters.
Kevin R: Add a cost guardrail: automatic downsampling after 90d unless customer opts-in for longer cold storage. That avoids unbounded spend.
Julian M: Heads-up from Sales — enterprise customers will push back on downsampling. We should include an escape hatch (paid extended retention) in the pricing notes and align with Revenue. Also propose an OKR tie: reduce infra cost-per-token by 12% while maintaining 99.9% dashboard availability.
Sarah C: Good call. Action items: 1) Kevin/Mike to draft technical constraints & downsampling design by EOD Tue; 2) Priya to outline docs/runbook; 3) Anita to gather 3 customer candidates for canary; 4) Julian to coordinate pricing language with BizOps. We'll finalize during roadmap review tomorrow.
